answer_1.quote: Given an image sequence I = {I n } 5 n=1 , Stylized Visual Storytelling (SVST) aims to generate a story s = {s n } 5 n=1 in a specific style...

answer_2.quote: Semantic relevance is measured by METEOR and CIDEr... Fluency is judged by the average perplexity score (ppl.) of three GPT-2 models... Style accuracy (CLS) is estimated by a style classifier...

answer_3.quote: Style accuracy (CLS) is estimated by a style classifier, which is fine-tuned from the BERT-base classifier... Fluency is judged by the average perplexity score (ppl.) of three GPT-2 models...

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluations using three metrics: (1) Relevance that measures relationship between the generated stories and the source photo stream...
answer_4.guideline: Following the standard in , relevance is rated from 0 (unrelated) to 3 (very related), coherence from 0 (unreadable) to 3 (perfect), and style appropriateness from 0 (bad) to 3 (perfect).
